description: Renovate is the single owner of dependency updates for this repo; keep repository-level (UI) Dependabot disabled.
Covers: Go modules (bootstrap/), Terraform providers (bpg/proxmox), GitHub Actions pins, and Talos/talosctl/sops/age/Kubernetes version pins via the custom regex managers below.

All Talos pins (tfvars, tfvars.example, CI talosctl install) are grouped into one PR so the cluster target version moves atomically. Talos upgrades are applied by a human runbook — the PR is a prompt, not an auto-rollout.

The Kubernetes pin is deliberately kept out of the Talos group. A Kubernetes bump is rolled out with `talosctl upgrade-k8s`, a separate human runbook from a Talos OS upgrade; grouping them would imply a coupling the rollout process does not have. Like the Talos PRs, a Kubernetes PR is a prompt, not an auto-rollout.

description: Kubernetes pins get a dedicated PR rather than the inherited org-wide non-major batch, so the cluster's Kubernetes target is never bumped as a side effect of reviewing an unrelated dependency batch.
allowedVersions rejects anything that is not a plain three-part release, keeping upstream alpha/beta/rc tags out of the PR stream without also suppressing new minors.

packageRules.description: A new Kubernetes minor can exceed the range the pinned Talos version supports, while a patch inside the running minor is always safe. Splitting them keeps the bump that needs a compatibility check from riding along with one that does not.
prBodyNotes: Before rolling this out, confirm the target release falls inside the Kubernetes range supported by the Talos version pinned in this repo (see that Talos release's notes). Apply with `talosctl upgrade-k8s`; bump `talos_version` first if the target is outside the supported range.
